evals.name: mirror-and-bump
evals.prompt: 릴리즈 완료되면 이미지 및 차트 미러링하고 전환경 차트 범프
evals.expected_output: Confirms workflow success and source artifacts first; copies the multi-arch index without `--platform`; switches to an in-cluster skopeo Job for layers over about 200 MB and cleans up; verifies digests; bumps every environment keeping overrides; ships via git-ship; never names the public source registry in internal text.

evals.name: status-failure
evals.expected_output: Reports run URL and per-job result, quotes the decisive error line, does not retry or re-tag automatically.

evals.name: status-only-scope
evals.expected_output: Runs only the Status stage; does not mirror or bump unasked.
